title: Roster Recovery & Frame Advantage Audit
description: Audit frame advantage across all fighters so recovery frames allow proper hit confirmation without inescapable infinite strings.

title: Cinematic Zoom and Screen Distortion for Critical Hits
description: Add director-style camera zoom on critical hits, super meter activation, and finishers. Implement smooth lerp to zoom 1.15-1.35 with punch-in on impact, subtle fisheye distortion, radial chromatic aberration, and a brief white flash. Ensure the zoom resets after 0.35 seconds and does not conflict with hitstop or camera shake.

title: Layered Audio Impact and Aura Sound Design
description: Create layered impact audio with a low thump, mid crack, high shimmer, and character-specific tone. Add pitch variation, stereo panning, and a reverb tail for arena impacts. Include aura activation, super charge, and hitstop sound stingers. Ensure audio pools are reused, volume ducks on critical hits, and no clipping occurs.

title: Advantage-Based Recovery and Punish Window Audit
description: Introduce advantage scoring for startup, active, recovery, and cancel windows. Tune recovery after block, whiff, and hit based on frame advantage and meter. Add a debug overlay showing advantage frames, and validate that no character has unsafe recovery longer than 12 frames on normal attacks and 18 frames on specials.
